descriptions.preferred: This medium-sized shrubby tree to 23 ft. (7 m) tall has stunning fall color. The leaves are a typical shape and size for the subspecies. Colored a glossy green, they contrast with clusters of red fruits from early summer onwards. Fall color is a fiery red. 'Flame' makes a fine specimen tree. It can also be used in a shrub border. Acer truncatum Purple-blow maple This species is very closely related to and quite similar to the painted maple, Acer pictum. Native to northern China, Manchuria, Siberia, North Korea, and the Japanese island of Sakhalin, it grows on the plains and lower mountain slopes at elevations of 330-2970 ft. (100-900 m) above sea level. This desirable maple grows into a large, wide-spreading bush or medium-sized tree 39-50 ft. (12-15 m) high. The bark is reputed to be the roughest and most deeply fissured of any maple. The attractive, deeply divided, glossy ivylike leaves are more deeply divided than those of the typical A. pictum, separating at least twothirds way toward the leaf base. The mediumsized leaves are mostly five-lobed often with a characteristically straight leaf base. Each triangular-ovate lobe has a long, slender, pointed tip. The center lobe may have one or a pair of broad, pointed teeth on the outer shoulder. The emerging leaves are an eye-catching red to purple shade, soon becoming glossy green for the summer, and turning to a brilliant shiny yelloworange in the fall with red and purple. The specific name means "truncated," referring to the often flat leaf base.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一种中等大小的灌木状小乔木，高可达 23 英尺（7 米），秋色极为出众。叶片形状和大小都属于该亚种的典型特征。叶色为有光泽的绿色，自初夏起与成簇的红色果实形成鲜明对比。秋季转为火焰般的红色。‘Flame’ 是极佳的标本树，也可用于灌木花境。Acer truncatum Purple-blow maple。该种与色木槭 Acer pictum 亲缘关系很近，整体也颇为相似。原产中国北部、满洲里地区、西伯利亚、朝鲜北部以及日本萨哈林岛，生长于海拔 330–2970 英尺（100–900 米）的平原及低山坡地。这个优良槭树种可生长为大型、开展的灌木，或中等大小乔木，高 39–50 英尺（12–15 米）。据称其树皮是所有槭树中最粗糙、纵裂最深者之一。其叶片美观，具光泽，形似常春藤，裂分比典型 A. pictum 更深，至少达到叶基方向的三分之二。中等大小叶片通常为 5 裂，且常具特征性的平直叶基。每个三角状卵形裂片都有细长尖锐的先端。中央裂片外侧肩部可能带有 1 枚或一对宽而尖的齿。新叶展开时呈醒目的红至紫色，很快在夏季转为有光泽的绿色；秋季则转为鲜亮闪耀的黄橙色，并带红色和紫色调。种加词意为“截形的”，指其叶基常呈平截状。
